name: akbun-contentcreator
description: Content creation skills for the faceless study channel 악분일상 — pick experiment-sized video topics, turn Obsidian study notes into problem→expectation→experiment→result scripts with 15-second hooks, make honest titles and thumbnail text, convert scripts to Tistory posts cross-linked with the video, cut under-60-second Shorts from result moments, and read YouTube Studio numbers into three concrete fixes for the next video

interface.shortDescription: Topics, scripts, titles, blog posts, Shorts and performance reviews for the faceless study channel 악분일상
interface.longDescription: Helps produce the YouTube channel 악분일상, a faceless study channel whose strength is checking official documentation by direct experiment. Every skill keeps the problem → expectation → experiment → result structure, never invents numbers, and links each video with its Tistory post. akbun-contentcreator-topic-finder scans official docs, security news and the blog's popular posts for five video candidates that fit one problem and one experiment. akbun-contentcreator-script-builder turns an Obsidian study note into a script in that order and writes three 15-second hooks. akbun-contentcreator-title-thumbnail makes five titles and three thumbnail phrases from a script and filters exaggerated or clickbait wording against the coaching document's title examples. akbun-contentcreator-blog-converter rewrites the script as a Tistory post with the video link at the top and a blog link line for the video description. akbun-contentcreator-shorts-cutter picks the result moments of the main video and writes two or three Shorts scripts under 60 seconds. akbun-contentcreator-performance-review reads YouTube Studio numbers the creator pastes in and returns three fixes to apply to the next video, asking for missing data instead of guessing.
defaultPrompt: 공식 문서·보안 뉴스·내 블로그 인기 글을 훑어서 '문제 하나, 실험 하나'로 풀 수 있는 영상 후보 5개 뽑아줘 (akbun-contentcreator-topic-finder)
이 옵시디언 공부 노트를 문제→예상→실험→결과 순서의 영상 대본으로 바꾸고 첫 15초 훅 3개 만들어줘 (akbun-contentcreator-script-builder)
이 대본으로 제목 5개와 썸네일 문구 3개 만들고 낚시성 표현은 걸러줘 (akbun-contentcreator-title-thumbnail)
이 영상 대본을 티스토리 글로 바꾸고 영상 링크와 블로그 링크를 서로 넣어줘 (akbun-contentcreator-blog-converter)
이 본편 대본에서 실험 결과가 나오는 순간을 골라 60초 이하 쇼츠 대본 2~3개 만들어줘 (akbun-contentcreator-shorts-cutter)
유튜브 스튜디오 숫자를 붙여 넣을게. 다음 영상에 바로 쓸 개선점 3가지로 정리해줘 (akbun-contentcreator-performance-review)
